## Policy and scope

All >1GB regular files anywhere in experiments/local, all non-cache/env/binary-data small files, all symlink aliases; excluded classes retained whole with counts and byte totals.

F11 task + supervisor ruling: one winning checkpoint per INDEPENDENT CMA RUN, not per top-level multi-family tree; official non-CMA weights remain AMBIGUOUS-KEEP unless docs-bound.

SEARCH-EVAL CHECKPOINT -> PURGE-DEFAULT only with eval .done + params.json evidence, excluding the fitness winner. SEARCH-RESULT -> KEEP. Exact docs file/alias path, filename or SHA (including documented prefixes) -> KEEP-PROTECTED. Unknown/non-CMA checkpoint -> AMBIGUOUS-KEEP. Generic mentions of a search root/data slice are context, not a blanket weight binding.

Threshold: >1GB decimal (1,000,000,000 bytes). All inventoried files have actual full SHA-256 in JSON. Cache/environment/data classes below threshold are not search-result artifacts and remain wholly retained. Symlink aliases never double-count target bytes.

Normative safety: **R07/R12/NDP15** checkpoint/restart preservation; **R16** evidence discipline. No resilient runtime behavior changed or conformance claimed.
